module.purpose: Provides the team appearance settings page, allowing authorized team administrators to configure theme, brand colors, and visibility or branding preferences.
module.summary: This client-side React module loads a team by route parameter, redirects when loading fails, and renders appearance controls for authorized administrators. It uses React Hook Form for theme and brand-color submissions, tRPC mutations for persistence, localized labels and notifications, optimistic local toggle state, and booking-page cache revalidation after successful updates. Unauthorized users receive an explanatory read-only message.
module.businessContext: Supports team branding and booking-page presentation in the scheduling product. If it fails, administrators cannot update team appearance or visibility controls, while booking pages may retain stale branding.

invariants.description: Appearance mutations use the loaded team's id.
Only members whose role passes checkAdminOrOwner receive editable controls.
Successful mutations reset submitted theme and brand-color forms to returned values.
The viewer team query is invalidated before success notification and booking cache revalidation.

assumptions.description: The route provides an id value usable by Number(params.id).
The team query returns membership role, appearance fields, slug, and optional parent slug.
The update mutation accepts partial appearance payloads keyed by team id.
The client-side tRPC and localization providers are initialized before this page renders.

ambiguities.question: Does the update mutation guarantee that returned theme and color values are normalized before form reset?
Can multiple toggle mutations overlap, and does the backend preserve their completion ordering?

concurrencyModel.notes: Rendering is synchronous, while team querying, mutations, invalidation, and cache revalidation are asynchronous. Toggle handlers can initiate separate mutations, and mutation controls are disabled while pending.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The team query returns an error.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Failed team loading must return the user to the teams page.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The team query is still pending.
moduleContractTests.rationale: The appearance page must provide a loading state before team data is available.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The loaded team member is neither an admin nor an owner.
moduleContractTests.then: the only_owner_change message is rendered and no appearance controls are rendered
moduleContractTests.rationale: Only team admins or owners may change appearance settings.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An admin changes the team theme to light or dark and submits the form.
moduleContractTests.when: mutation.mutate({ id: team.id, theme: theme === "light" || theme === "dark" ? theme : null })
moduleContractTests.then: the team update mutation is called with the team id and selected theme
moduleContractTests.rationale: Theme selection must persist only the supported light and dark values.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A team update succeeds with updated theme and brand colors.
moduleContractTests.then: resetTheme({ theme: res.theme }) and resetBrandColors({ brandColor: res.brandColor ?? DEFAULT_LIGHT_BRAND_COLOR, darkBrandColor: res.darkBrandColor ?? DEFAULT_DARK_BRAND_COLOR })
moduleContractTests.rationale: Successful persistence must synchronize both forms with server values and defaults.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A successful update returns a team slug.
moduleContractTests.when: revalidateTeamDataCache({ teamSlug: res?.slug, orgSlug: team?.parent?.slug ?? null })
moduleContractTests.then: the team booking page cache is revalidated for the returned team and parent organization slugs
moduleContractTests.rationale: Appearance changes must become visible on the team booking page.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An admin submits brand color values.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Both light and dark brand colors must be submitted with the owning team id.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An admin changes the disable Cal branding toggle.
moduleContractTests.when: onCheckedChange={(checked) => { setHideBrandingValue(checked); mutation.mutate({ id: team.id, hideBranding: checked }); }}
moduleContractTests.then: the local toggle state changes and the update mutation receives hideBranding: checked
moduleContractTests.rationale: Branding visibility must update immediately and persist the selected boolean.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An admin changes the hide book-a-team-member toggle.
moduleContractTests.when: onCheckedChange={(checked) => { setHideBookATeamMember(checked); mutation.mutate({ id: team.id, hideBookATeamMember: checked }); }}
moduleContractTests.then: the local toggle state changes and the update mutation receives hideBookATeamMember: checked
moduleContractTests.rationale: The team member booking visibility setting must be persisted as a boolean.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An admin changes the hide team profile link toggle.
moduleContractTests.when: onCheckedChange={(checked) => { setHideTeamProfileLink(checked); mutation.mutate({ id: team.id, hideTeamProfileLink: checked }); }}
moduleContractTests.then: the local toggle state changes and the update mutation receives hideTeamProfileLink: checked
moduleContractTests.rationale: The team profile link visibility setting must be persisted as a boolean.
